rationale: bugs_open/155 close-out, contributing to bugs_open/209 Phase 3: retire the readerless {purpose}_uri writers, and align asset-deployer's input_contract with the identity path the action has had since 91dda3243. 155's defect was a site-wide, last-write-wins purpose-keyed cache standing in for a per-asset fact — six icon deploys shipped byte-identical files with success:true. The reading side is fully dead at HEAD: resolveStorageURIFromAsset's DB purpose-cache branch was deleted 2026-08-06 (1d11827c1, live v1.0.1259) and findStorageURI itself — the in-run {purpose}_uri consumer kept 'for the legacy pageflow flow' — was deleted 2026-08-09 (91dda3243, 209 Phase 2, live v1.0.1276, pod-verified with negative control). But the WRITERS survived: StoreGeneratedImageAction still writes the DB cache itself (generate_image_actions.go:1009-1012 updateSiteContentField purpose+"_uri") plus collected_data (:1027) and an in-memory copy (:1032), and StoreAssetAction still writes the collected_data copy (v3_site_actions.go:3458-3460) under a comment whose justification ('the legacy pageflow deploy step reads it within the same workflow') has been false since 91dda3243. Measured readerless before deletion, four surfaces: (1) Go — zero readers of purpose+"_uri"/hero_uri/logo_uri/icon_uri outside doc comments and the regression test that ASSERTS nothing reads them; (2) live agent_definitions jsonb workflow configs — every _uri mention resolves to generator outputs (image_uri), step-namespaced s3_uri, or the 348-shape {purpose}_stored.s3_uri, never a flat {purpose}_uri; (3) workflow_templates — zero; (4) active content_components templates — zero. Bonus census: store_generated_image appears in ZERO agent_definitions rows, active or not — the surviving DB write is doubly dead (no caller, no reader). Deleting the writers (keeping every {purpose}_url write, which templates do read) closes 155's class structurally: the cache no longer exists to be read wrongly, and it sharpens migration 324's old-binary tripwire (content_data gaining a {purpose}_uri after the roll now has zero legitimate writers). Sibling config half, applied+recorded 2026-08-22: migration 553 relaxes asset-deployer's input_contract from required:[domain,s3_uri] to required:[domain] with s3_uri/asset_id optional — the contract was the last place still asserting the pre-155 world and it hard-refused (ValidateInputContract, input_mapping.go:301-329) the asset_id-only dispatch that 155's own closure recipe demands; blast radius measured: exactly ONE live step is contract-validated (image-build-handler call_asset_deployer, literal agent_type + input_mapping) and it maps both keys.

edits.sketch:
UPDATE agent_definitions
SET input_contract = jsonb_build_object(
      'required', '["domain"]'::jsonb,
      'optional', '["s3_uri","asset_id","purpose","asset_key"]'::jsonb,
      'description', 'Provide domain plus ONE of s3_uri ... or asset_id ...'),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE type='asset-deployer' AND is_active AND COALESCE(is_snapshot,false)=false AND deleted_at IS NULL
  AND input_contract->'required' = '["domain","s3_uri"]'::jsonb;
DO $$ ... IF c->'required' IS DISTINCT FROM '["domain"]'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ... $$;
